heads.la: CAPUT PRIMUM. Harum sanctarum virginum pietas, captivitas et in captivitate libertas.
heads.en: CHAPTER ONE. The devotion of these holy virgins, their captivity, and their freedom in captivity.

heads.la: CAPUT II. Virginum e captivitate liberatio, reditus ad Romam et martyrium una cum suo raptore.
heads.en: CHAPTER II. The virgins' deliverance from captivity, their return to Rome, and their martyrdom together with the man who carried them off.

heads.la: CAPUT III. Sanctorum corporum sepultura et translatio.
heads.en: CHAPTER III. The burial and translation of the holy bodies.
